assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one transparent wildlife texture atlas for a three-dimensional grassland website. Create a square high-resolution 2048x2048 PNG atlas with exactly four equal square quadrants, NO visible grid lines, pure transparent alpha everywhere around the animals. Top LEFT quadrant: one full-body adult male African lion, handsome dark tawny realistic mane, standing naturally in side profile facing RIGHT. Top RIGHT quadrant: one full-body Bengal tiger, anatomically accurate orange-black stripes and white belly, standing naturally in side profile facing LEFT. Bottom LEFT quadrant: one full-body adult giraffe, graceful very long neck, irregular brown patches and realistic thin legs, standing naturally in side profile facing LEFT. Bottom RIGHT quadrant: one full-body adult plains zebra, accurate fine black and white stripes, standing naturally in side profile facing RIGHT. All four look like high-quality wildlife photographs, absolutely not toys, not cartoon, not plastic, not stylized 3D. Fine fur, natural musculature, correct small eyes, four correct legs, realistic paws/hooves, complete tails, complete ears. Warm soft late afternoon outdoor light from upper left, subtle natural shadows on bodies, no cast ground shadow and no ground, no horizon, no plants or landscape. Each animal must be isolated entirely within its own quadrant, comfortably centered horizontally, with approximately 8 percent clear padding from all quadrant borders; feet aligned at 92 percent height within each quadrant. Fill available space with each animal in its correct natural aspect ratio, keeping giraffe tall and narrow and lion/tiger/zebra wide. Every animal's entire body, paws, head, mane and tail must be visible and must not touch another quadrant. No text, no letters, no labels, no watermark. True transparent background, not a checkerboard image. This is a functional texture atlas, exact quadrant separation is essential.
assets.purpose: Photographic wildlife texture atlas for the Three.js grassland. Generated artwork, not photographs of specific real animals.

assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square PBR color texture for a real acacia tree trunk in a Three.js grassland scene. Generate a high-resolution, tileable photographic close-up of natural mature acacia bark, viewed straight on, perfectly flat perspective, no visible tree edges or background. Rough weathered gray-brown wood, fine irregular deep vertical fissures that split and meander, subtly flaking narrow organic bark ridges, very fine grain and dusty taupe variation, a little muted olive lichen in occasional spots. All bark ridges should be irregular and natural, NOT rectangular tiles, NOT brickwork, NOT planks, NO regular grid, NO repeated obvious pattern, NO orange or red cast. Even soft diffuse daylight with no strong cast shadows or specular highlights baked into the image, suitable as base color and bump reference. Texture must cover entire square edge to edge and tile naturally on all sides. No text, no watermarks, no objects, no foliage, no white margins. Match a convincing real tree photograph, not an illustration, cartoon, videogame painted texture, plastic, or stylized 3D render.
assets.purpose: Generated photographic acacia bark color texture for tree trunks and attached navigation branches.
